description: iPify helps intellectual-property professionals calculate deadlines and budget costs for patent and design renewals, European patent validations, and PCT national-phase entries. Check supported services and required case information, simulate individual cases or portfolios, and explore deadlines, official fees, assumptions, and cost charts. Use supplied case data, imported CSV portfolios, planned filings, or onboarded cases you can access in iPify. Applicable iPify agreements provide customer-specific quoted prices. Imports and simulation results are retained in your private history until expiry. Simulations do not instruct filings, pay fees, or change managed cases.

defaultPrompt: What renewal costs will I pay for a patent filed in India today and granted in 5 years?
